verses.text: Long time ago God talk to di forefathers through di prophets, for many parts and for many ways,
but for dese last days e don talk to us through im Pikin, wey e make heir of everything, and through am e make di worlds too.

Na im Pikin be di shining of im glory and di exact image of im nature, and e dey hold everything with di word of im power. When e don make purification for sins by imself, e sit down for di right hand of di Majesty for high place;
as e don become better pass di angels, just as di name wey e inherit better pass dem own.
Because which angel God ever talk say, “You na my Pikin, today I don become your Papa”? And again, “I go be Papa to am, and e go be Pikin to me”?
And when e bring di firstborn enter di world again, e talk say, “Make all God angels worship am.”
About di angels e talk say, “Na im dey make im angels like wind, and im servants like flame of fire.”
But about im Pikin e talk say, “God, your throne dey forever and ever. Di scepter of rightness na di scepter of your Kingdom.
“You love righteousness and hate wickedness. So God, your God, don anoint you with di oil of gladness pass your companions.”
And, “You, Lord, for di beginning lay di foundation of di earth, and di heavens na di work of your hands.
“Dem go perish, but you go remain. Dem all go old like cloth.
“Like coat you go fold dem, and dem go change; but you na di same, and your years no go finish.”
But which of di angels God ever tell say, “Sit for my right hand, until I make your enemies di footstool for your feet”?
Di angels no be all of dem serving spirits, wey dem send go serve for di sake of dem wey go inherit salvation?
So we must give more attention to di things wey we don hear, so that we no go drift comot.
Because if di word wey angels talk dey strong, and every wrong and disobedience receive di right punishment,
how we go escape if we ignore so big salvation, wey Lord first talk, and dem wey hear am confirm am to us,
while God dey testify with dem too, through signs and wonders, and different works of power, and gifts of Holy Spirit, according to im own will?
Because God no put di world wey dey come, wey we dey talk about, under angels.
But somebody don testify for one place say, “Wetin be man, say you dey think about am? Or di Son of Man, say you dey care for am?
“You make am small lower pass di angels. You crown am with glory and honor, and you put everything under im feet.”
Because as God put everything under am, e no leave anything wey no dey under am. But now we never see everything dey under am.
But we see Jesus, wey dem make small lower pass di angels, now dem don crown am with glory and honor because of di suffering of death, so that by God grace e go taste death for everybody.
Because e fit God, for who everything dey and through who everything dey, as e dey bring plenty pikin dem enter glory, to make di author of dem salvation perfect through suffering.
Because both di one wey dey make people holy and dem wey e make holy all come from one Papa, so e no shame to call dem brothers,
as e talk say, “I go declare your name to my brothers. For di middle of di congregation I go sing your praise.”
And again, “I go put my trust for am.” And again, “Look, I dey here with di pikin dem wey God give me.”
So since di pikin dem share for flesh and blood, e too take part for di same thing, so that through death e go destroy di one wey get power of death, wey be di devil,
and free dem wey fear of death don make slave all dem life.
Because e no dey help angels, but e dey help Abraham pikin dem.
So e must be like im brothers for everything, so that e go be merciful and faithful high priest for things wey concern God, to make atonement for di sins of di people.
Because as e imself suffer when dem tempt am, e fit help dem wey dem dey tempt.
So, holy brothers, una wey share for heavenly calling, make una consider Jesus, di Apostle and High Priest of our confession;
e dey faithful to di one wey appoint am, just as Moses dey faithful for all im house.
Because dem count am worthy of more glory pass Moses, just as di one wey build di house get more honor pass di house.
Because somebody dey build every house; but na God build everything.
Moses dey faithful for all im house as servant, to testify about di things wey dem go talk later,
but Christ dey faithful as Pikin over im house; and we be im house, if we hold our confidence and di pride of our hope firm reach di end.
So, just as Holy Spirit talk say, “Today if una hear im voice,
“no make una heart hard, as e be for di rebellion, like for di day of di test for di wilderness,
“wia una forefathers test me and try me, and see my deeds for 40 years.
“So I vex with dat generation, and I talk say, ‘Dem heart dey always miss road, and dem no know my ways;’
“so I swear for my wrath, ‘Dem no go enter my rest.’”
Brothers, make una take care, so that evil heart wey no believe no go dey inside any of una, wey go make am turn comot from di God wey dey alive;
but make una encourage each other every day, as long as dem still dey call am “today,” so that sin deceit no go make any of una heart hard.
Because we don share for Christ, if we hold di beginning of our confidence firm reach di end:
as dem talk say, “Today if una hear im voice, no make una heart hard, as e be for di rebellion.”
Because who hear and rebel? No be all dem wey comot from Egypt through Moses?
Who God vex with for 40 years? No be dem wey sin, wey dem body fall for di wilderness?
Who e swear to say dem no go enter im rest, if no be dem wey disobey?
So we see say dem no fit enter because of unbelief.
So make we fear, so that nobody among una go look like say e no reach di promise to enter im rest.
Because dem don preach Good News to us just as dem preach to dem, but di word wey dem hear no profit dem, because dem wey hear no join am with faith.
Because we wey believe dey enter dat rest, just as e talk say, “So I swear for my wrath, dem no go enter my rest”; even though di works finish since di foundation of di world.
Because e talk for one place about di seventh day say, “God rest for di seventh day from all im works”;
and for dis place again, “Dem no go enter my rest.”
So since e remain say some people go enter am, and dem wey first hear di Good News no enter because of disobedience,
e again fix one day, “today,” as e talk through David after plenty time, as dem don talk before: “Today if una hear im voice, no make una heart hard.”
Because if Joshua don give dem rest, God no go talk about another day later.
So rest like Sabbath still remain for God people.
Because di person wey enter im rest don rest from im works too, just as God rest from im own.
So make we try well well to enter dat rest, so that nobody go fall like dem for di same example of disobedience.

Because God word dey alive and e get power, e sharp pass any sword wey get two edges, e dey pierce reach wia soul and spirit divide, joints and marrow, and e dey judge di thoughts and intentions of di heart.
No creature dey wey hide from im sight, but everything dey naked and open before di eyes of di one wey we must give account to.
So since we get great high priest, wey don pass through di heavens, Jesus, God Pikin, make we hold our confession tight.
Because we no get high priest wey no fit feel our weakness dem, but one wey dem tempt for every way like us, but e no sin.
So make we come near di throne of grace with boldness, so that we go receive mercy and find grace to help us for time of need.
Because dem dey take every high priest from among men and appoint am for men for things wey concern God, so that e go offer gifts and sacrifices for sins,
e fit dey gentle with dem wey no know and dem wey wander, because weakness dey surround imself too.
Because of dis, e must offer sacrifice for sins for di people, and for imself too.
Nobody dey take dis honor for imself, but God dey call am, just as e call Aaron.
Na so Christ no give imself glory to become high priest, but na di one wey talk to am say, “You na my Pikin. Today I don become your Papa.”
As e talk for another place too, “You na priest forever, according to di order of Melchizedek.”
For di days of im flesh, e offer prayers and requests with loud cry and tears to di one wey fit save am from death, and God hear am because of im respect for God,
even though e be Pikin, e still learn obedience through di things wey e suffer.
When dem don make am perfect, e become di author of salvation wey no dey end to all dem wey obey am,
as God name am high priest according to di order of Melchizedek.
We get plenty things to talk about am, and e hard to explain, because una don dull for hearing.
Because by now, because of di time, una suppose don be teachers, but una still need make person teach una again di first basic things of God words. Una don come need milk, no be solid food.
Because everybody wey dey live on milk no get experience for di word of righteousness, because e na baby.
But solid food na for dem wey don grow, wey dey use dem senses plenty to know wetin good and wetin evil.
So make we leave di first teaching about Christ and go forward to maturity, no be to lay foundation again of repentance from dead works and of faith for God,
of teaching about baptisms, laying on of hands, resurrection of di dead and judgment wey no dey end.
We go do dis one, if God allow.
Because about dem wey God don light before, wey taste di gift from heaven, and share for Holy Spirit,
and taste di good word of God and di powers of di age wey dey come,
and den fall away, e no possible to bring dem back to repentance again; because dem dey crucify God Pikin again for demself and dey put am for open shame.
Because land wey don drink di rain wey dey fall on am often, and produce crop wey good for dem wey farm am, dey receive blessing from God;
but if e dey bear thorns and weeds, dem go reject am and e near curse, and fire na im end.
But, dear ones, even though we dey talk like dis, we sure of better things for una, things wey follow salvation.
Because God no be unrighteous, to forget una work and di labor of love wey una show for im name, as una serve di holy people and una still dey serve dem.
We want make each one of una show di same hard work reach di fullness of hope till di end,
so that una no go dey lazy, but una go follow dem wey inherit di promises through faith and patience.
Because when God make promise to Abraham, as e no get anybody bigger to swear by, e swear by imself,
as e talk say, “I go bless you well well, and I go multiply you well well.”
So after e wait with patience, e receive di promise.
Because men dey swear by person wey bigger pass dem, and for every argument of dem, di oath na di final thing wey dey confirm am.
So God, as e wan show di heirs of di promise more clear say im plan no dey change, take oath enter between;
so that through two things wey no dey change, wey e no possible make God lie inside, we wey don run go hide go get strong encouragement to hold di hope wey dey before us.
We get dis hope like anchor for di soul, hope wey sure and strong, wey dey enter inside di veil;
wia Jesus enter for us as person wey go before us, as e don become high priest forever according to di order of Melchizedek.
Because dis Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, meet Abraham as e dey come back from di battle wey e kill di kings, and bless am,
and Abraham give am one tenth of everything. First, as dem translate im name, e mean “king of righteousness,” and den “king of Salem” too, wey mean “king of peace,”
without papa, without mama, without genealogy, no get beginning of days or end of life, but dem make am like God Pikin, and e remain priest all di time.
Now see how big dis man be, wey even Abraham, di patriarch, give one tenth from di best things wey e carry for war.
Di sons of Levi wey receive di priest work get command to collect tithe from di people according to di law, dat na from dem brothers, even though dem too come from Abraham body;
but dis one wey dem no count im genealogy from dem collect tithe from Abraham, and bless di one wey get di promises.
And no argument dey say di smaller one dey receive blessing from di bigger one.
Here, people wey dey die dey collect tithe, but there, na one person collect am wey dem testify say e dey alive.
As e be, Levi too wey dey collect tithe don pay tithe through Abraham,
because e still dey inside im forefather body when Melchizedek meet am.

Now if perfection dey through di Levite priesthood, because under am di people receive di law, why another priest go still need to rise according to di order of Melchizedek, and dem no call am according to di order of Aaron?
Because as dem don change di priesthood, di law must change too.
Because di one wey dem talk dese things about come from another tribe, wey nobody from am ever serve for di altar.
Because e clear say our Lord come from Judah, and Moses no talk anything about priesthood for dat tribe.
E still dey more clear if another priest rise like Melchizedek,
wey dem make no be according to di law of commandment for flesh, but according to di power of life wey no dey end:
because dem testify say, “You na priest forever, according to di order of Melchizedek.”
Because dem don cancel di first command because e weak and no dey useful,
because di law no make anything perfect, and dem bring in better hope, wey we dey use come near God.
And e no happen without oath;

because dem make dem priest without oath, but e become priest with oath by di one wey talk to am say, “Di Lord swear and e no go change im mind, ‘You na priest forever, according to di order of Melchizedek.’”
So Jesus don become di guarantee of better covenant.
Plenty of dem don become priests, because death dey stop dem from continue.
But because e dey alive forever, im priesthood no dey change.
So e fit save to di fullest dem wey come near God through am, as e dey alive forever to make intercession for dem.
Because na dis kind high priest fit us: holy, innocent, clean, separate from sinners, and dem make am higher pass di heavens;
wey no need, like dose high priests, to offer sacrifice every day, first for im own sins, den for di sins of di people. Because e do am one time for all, when e offer imself.
Because di law dey appoint men wey get weakness as high priests, but di word of di oath wey come after di law appoint Pikin wey dem don make perfect forever.
Now for di things wey we dey talk, di main point na dis: We get high priest like dis, wey sit down for di right hand of di throne of di Majesty for heaven,
as servant of di holy place and of di true tabernacle, wey di Lord set up, no be man.
Because dem dey appoint every high priest to offer gifts and sacrifices. So dis high priest must get something to offer too.
If e dey for earth, e no go even be priest, because people dey wey dey offer gifts according to di law,

wey dey serve for copy and shadow of di things for heaven, just as God warn Moses when e wan make di tabernacle, because e talk say, “Make sure say you make everything according to di pattern wey dem show you for di mountain.”
But now e don get better service, just as e be mediator of better covenant, wey dem found on better promises.
Because if di first covenant no get fault, dem no go look for place for second one.
Because as e find fault with dem, e talk say, “Look, di days dey come, di Lord talk, wey I go make new covenant with di house of Israel and di house of Judah;
“no be like di covenant wey I make with dem forefathers, for di day wey I hold dem hand to lead dem comot from Egypt. Because dem no continue for my covenant, and I ignore dem, di Lord talk.

“Because dis na di covenant wey I go make with di house of Israel after dose days, di Lord talk: I go put my laws inside dem mind, I go write dem for dem heart too. I go be dem God, and dem go be my people.
“Dem no go teach each person im neighbor, and each person im brother, say, ‘Know di Lord,’ because all of dem go know me, from di smallest to di biggest.
“Because I go show mercy for dem wickedness. I no go remember dem sins and lawless deeds again.”
As e talk say, “New covenant,” e don make di first one old. And wetin dey old and dey grow old near to disappear.
Now even di first covenant get rules for worship and earthly holy place.
Because dem prepare tabernacle, di first part, wey get di lampstand, di table and di show bread; dem dey call am di Holy Place.
Behind di second veil na another tabernacle wey dem dey call di Holy of Holies,
wey get gold altar of incense and di ark of di covenant wey dem cover everywhere with gold, wey inside get gold pot wey hold di manna, Aaron rod wey bud, and di tablets of di covenant;
and above am di cherubim of glory dey cover di mercy seat; we no fit talk about dese things one by one now.
Now as dem don prepare dese things like dis, di priests dey always enter di first tabernacle to do dem service,
but na only di high priest dey enter di second one, one time for year, no without blood, wey e dey offer for imself and for di errors of di people.
Holy Spirit dey show dis one clear, say di way enter di Holy Place never open while di first tabernacle still dey stand;
wey be symbol for dis present age, wia dem dey offer gifts and sacrifices wey no fit make di person wey dey worship perfect for conscience;
dem na only rules for flesh about food, drink and different washings, wey dem put until di time of correction.
But Christ don come as high priest of di good things wey dey come, through di bigger and more perfect tabernacle, wey hand no make, dat na to say, e no be part of dis creation,
no be through di blood of goats and calves, but through im own blood, e enter di Holy Place one time for all, as e don win freedom wey no dey end.
Because if di blood of goats and bulls and di ashes of young cow wey dem sprinkle on dem wey dirty dey make dem holy for body cleanness,
how much more go di blood of Christ, wey through di Spirit wey no dey end offer imself without fault to God, clean una conscience from dead works so that una go serve di God wey dey alive?

Na why e be mediator of new covenant, so that as death don happen to free people from di wrongs wey dey under di first covenant, dem wey God call go receive di promise of di inheritance wey no dey end.
Because wia testament dey, di death of di person wey make am must happen.
Because testament dey work only after death, because e no dey work at all while di person wey make am still dey alive.
So even di first covenant no start without blood.
Because when Moses don talk every command to all di people according to di law, e take di blood of di calves and goats, with water, red wool and hyssop, and sprinkle di book imself and all di people,
as e talk say, “Dis na di blood of di covenant wey God command una.”
E sprinkle di tabernacle and all di things wey dem dey use for service with di blood too.
According to di law, nearly everything dem dey clean with blood, and without blood to pour, forgiveness no dey.
So e must be say dem go clean di copies of di things for heaven with dese ones, but di heavenly things demself with better sacrifices pass dese.
Because Christ no enter holy place wey hand make, wey be copy of di true one, but e enter heaven imself, to appear now before God for us;
no be say e go offer imself many times, like di high priest wey dey enter di Holy Place every year with blood wey no be im own;
if no be so, e for suffer many times since di foundation of di world. But now, one time for di end of di ages, e show to comot sin through di sacrifice of imself.
As dem don appoint am say men go die one time, and after dat na judgment,
na so Christ too, as dem don offer am one time to carry di sins of plenty people, go appear second time, without sin, to dem wey dey wait for am with strong desire for salvation.

Because di law get shadow of di good things wey dey come, no be di real image of di things, e no fit ever make perfect dem wey come near with di same sacrifices wey dem dey offer every year all di time.
If e no be so, dem for don stop to offer dem, because di worshipers, as dem don clean one time, no go get conscience of sins again?
But for dose sacrifices, reminder of sins dey every year.
Because e no possible make di blood of bulls and goats take sins away.
So when e come di world, e talk say, “Sacrifice and offering you no want, but you prepare body for me;
“for burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you no get pleasure.
“Den I talk say, ‘Look, I don come, as dem write about me for di scroll of di book, to do your will, God.’”
First e talk say, “You no want and you no get pleasure for sacrifices and offerings and burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin,” dem wey dem dey offer according to di law,
den e talk say, “Look, I don come to do your will.” E remove di first so that e go establish di second,
and by dis will dem don make us holy through di offering of di body of Jesus Christ one time for all.
Every priest dey stand every day to serve and dey offer di same sacrifices many times, wey no fit ever take sins away,
but dis one, after e offer one sacrifice for sins forever, e sit down for di right hand of God;
from dat time e dey wait until dem make im enemies di footstool for im feet.
Because by one offering e don make perfect forever dem wey e dey make holy.
Holy Spirit dey testify to us too, because after e talk say,
“Dis na di covenant wey I go make with dem after dose days, di Lord talk: I go put my laws for dem heart, I go write dem for dem mind too,”
den e talk say, “I no go remember dem sins and dem wickedness again.”
Now wia forgiveness of dese dey, offering for sin no dey again.
So, brothers, as we get boldness to enter di holy place by di blood of Jesus,
through di way wey e open for us, new and living way, through di veil, dat na to say, im flesh,
and as we get great priest over God house,
make we come near with true heart and full faith, as dem don sprinkle our heart to comot evil conscience, and dem don wash our body with clean water,
make we hold di confession of our hope tight without shake; because di one wey promise dey faithful.
Make we think how we go encourage each other to love and good works,
no make we leave our own gathering together, as some people dey do, but make we encourage each other, and more as una see di Day dey come near.
Because if we sin on purpose after we don receive di knowledge of di truth, sacrifice for sins no remain again,
but na only fearful waiting for judgment and fierce fire wey go finish di enemies.
Person wey ignore Moses law dey die without mercy if two or three witnesses talk.

How much worse punishment una think say di person go deserve, wey don trample God Pikin under im feet, and count di blood of di covenant wey make am holy as unholy thing, and insult di Spirit of grace?
Because we know di one wey talk say, “Vengeance na mine; I go pay back,” di Lord talk. And again, “Di Lord go judge im people.”
E dey fearful to fall inside di hands of di God wey dey alive.
But remember di former days, wey after dem don light una, una endure big struggle with sufferings:
some time dem dey insult una and dey oppress una before people, and some time una join dem wey dem dey treat so.
Because una show compassion to me for my chain, and una gladly accept as dem carry una property go, because una know say una get better property wey go last for heaven.
So no throw away una boldness, wey get big reward.
Because una need patience, so that after una don do God will, una go receive di promise.
“For small time, di one wey dey come go come, and e no go late.
“But di righteous go live by faith. If e shrink back, my soul no get pleasure for am.”
But we no be among dem wey shrink back go destruction, but among dem wey get faith to save di soul.
